sections.description:
A new patch is now live on Windows PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes.

To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum.

blocks.title: Summer Games 2018
blocks.body:
The Summer Games return for more fun in the sun! This year, we're celebrating the spirit of competition with a new Lúcioball arena, Season 2 of Copa Lúcioball, and a smörgåsbord of loot. Unlock over 50 new seasonal items—including legendary skins like Waveracer D.Va, Fastball Zenyatta, and Cabana Ana—alongside our growing collection of summer gear from previous years.

To learn more about Summer Games, click here.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body:
- Changed the name of Junkrat’s Buccaneer skin to Bilgerat
- Added under attack voice lines for Zenyatta, Lúcio, and Moria
- All Overwatch League skins now include the name of the team’s city or state

blocks.title: Looking for Group
blocks.body: - Settings will be saved after changing filters on the Looking for Group browse screen

blocks.title: Hero Gallery
blocks.body: - Added a What’s New option that displays new unlockable content

heroes.dev_note: These changes help Ana’s Nano Boost be usable in more situations. Previously it was almost entirely used to combo with other allies’ ultimates, just before they use them. With this change Nano Boost can now alternatively be used to save an ally from near death in the middle of a big fight.

changes.text_en: Now also instantly heals the target for 300 health

heroes.dev_note: Brigitte’s Shield Bash is one of her strongest abilities, and its short cooldown can make it difficult to play against. Slightly increasing its cooldown will give her opponents more opportunity to play around it. We’ve also added an option to control Brigitte’s Repair Pack targeting sensitivity which will allow players to reduce the width of the search angle for the ability. This is useful for trying to target specific allies in the middle of a fight at the cost of making it a bit harder to target allies in general.

changes.text_en: An option to control Brigitte’s Repair Pack targeting sensitivity has been added under Options > Controls > Brigitte

heroes.dev_note: These changes are just quality of life improvements for how Doomfist interacts with Symmetra’s placed objects.

changes.text_en: Now destroys Symmetra’s sentry turrets without stopping his movement

heroes.dev_note: Hanzo’s Lunge ability allows him to be a bit too evasive, so we’re increasing the cooldown to make him easier to catch.

Increasing the amount of shield health gained from Lúcio’s Sound Barrier should make it more effective against incoming burst damage. As part of his last rework, Crossfade’s radius was heavily reduced, but its potency was increased to compensate. While the change was better for him overall, the radius was small enough that it was often difficult to keep his allies in range during a fight, even if they felt reasonably close together. The increased radius should help in these situations.

changes.text_en: Aura radius increase from 10 to 12 meters
Temporary shields granted increased from 500 to 750

heroes.dev_note: Mercy’s previous healing output made her nearly irreplaceable in any team composition. Even after this change she will still be able to deliver more healing over the course of a match than any other support hero, but it should allow for other healers to be more viable.

changes.text_en: Healing beam reduced from 60 healing per second to 50 healing per second

heroes.dev_note: This change should help Moira in situations where there are no enemies within reach but your team still requires a lot of healing. She will still need to drain enemies to be fully effective, but this just helps her a bit in the rare cases where there is an extended long-range fight that she can’t reasonably take part in.

changes.text_en: Passive energy regeneration rate increased from 2 per second to 2.4 per second

heroes.dev_note: By smoothing out Reinhardt’s Barrier Field, he now will be able to consistently block enemy abilities and projectiles that could sometimes unintentionally sneak through (e.g. Junkrat’s grenades).

changes.text_en: Decorative insignia no longer protrudes from the shield’s surface

heroes.dev_note: The head changes are mostly a bug fix, as her head hit volume was abnormally large, especially from behind. Previously if you fired at her from behind near her upper spine, you could land a head shot. Now her head volume is much more accurate.

changes.text_en: Reduced the size of Sombra’s head hit volume

heroes.dev_note: Symmetra’s primary fire has huge damage potential but it is too difficult to charge because of its low range and slow charge rate. We’re increasing the range to see how it plays out, giving her more opportunities to use it, especially against enemy barriers.

changes.text_en: Primary fire range increased from 10 to 12

heroes.dev_note: The increased cooldown will slightly reduce the frequency that Widowmaker can reposition herself. This allows her to be threatened more easily by agile enemy heroes such as Winston and Genji.

changes.text_en: Cooldown increased from 8 seconds to 10 seconds

heroes.dev_note: The smaller radius on Graviton Surge makes it more reasonable for her enemies to try countering it by staying spread out, as well as putting more focus on Zarya to position the ultimate correctly to impact the most players possible. However, the intent of these changes isn’t to lessen Zarya’s overall power significantly so we’re reducing her energy drain rate, which should keep her energy higher on average resulting in more damage and quicker ultimate charge times. Overall, this takes some power out of her ultimate and distributes it else ware to add more counter play against her.

changes.text_en: Drain rate reduced from 2 energy per second to 1.6 energy per second

blocks.title: General
blocks.body:
- Some ultimate abilities now restore ammunition after completion for some heroes


  - **Abilities affected:** Genji’s Dragonblade, Junkrat’s RIP-Tire, Pharah’s Barrage, Roadhog’s Whole Hog, and Zenyatta’s Transcendence, Winston’s Primal Rage
blocks.dev: The change removes the need to immediately reload after a long duration ultimate.

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body: - Brigitte’s Repair Pack now has a minimum cooldown time of 1.5 seconds regardless of custom game settings

blocks.title: General
blocks.body:
- Fixed a bug that displayed an inaccurate AFK countdown timer before removing players from a match if they were flagged as AFK more than once
- Fixed a bug that caused the player camera to display an odd location before switching to the first-person view of the selected hero after Assemble Your Team phase ends

blocks.title: AI
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that caused Torbjörn bot to fire his gun endlessly if his turret is teleported by a Symmetra player

blocks.title: Competitive Play
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that could cause players to lose an endorsement level if they exited before a match completes, but after the return timer for a leaving player has expired

blocks.title: Hero Gallery
blocks.body:
- Fixed a bug that prevented rotating hero models while viewed in the Hero Gallery when equipped with Overwatch League skins
- Fixed a bug that prevented the Communication Wheel from functioning when equipping a spray, voice line, or emote from a Loot Box

blocks.title: Looking for Group
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that caused some groups to be unable to queue for a game mode

- Fixed a bug that caused Eichenwalde’s castle gate to falls into the ground when destroyed by the payload
